fieldsA.by: art-prep/realm/fields-bake.mjs; qc-pack fieldsBake checks it byte for byte against GROUND load()

grid.tile: tile = deed·98 + local, origin at the pack grid

atlas.rule: family layer = families[M] + mask (0..15); mask 15 may instead take pureUpper[M] first + kitHash(cell) % count (8 variants break the 7-tile repeat)
atlas.wangRule: pureWang[M] = [first, 16] (option-E uppers with props): layer = first + (c(NW)<<3 | c(NE)<<2 | c(SW)<<1 | c(SE)) with c(i,j) = kitHash(i ^ 0x5a1, j ^ 0x2c3) & 1 at lattice vertex (i,j), FORCED to 0 unless the four cells around that vertex are all pure M (so every family/pure boundary is colour 0); seamless for any cell, removes the 7-tile repeat of the classic pick

M4.brief: rock <-> snow peaks, ONLY if the SNOW class share >= 0.5 % (fields.mjs report), else skipped

mask.channels: R = upper class, G = 1-px rim (RGB, no alpha); same grid and mip rows as mapkit.png

plotStyle.edgeSource: kit fence_ew ink (30–80 % luma mean, 5th, 93rd percentile)

tone.encoding: rgb = 128 × (lowpass chart / lowpass map colour), clamp 0.5–1.99; water = 128

mask.channels: R = upper class, G = 1-px rim (RGB); family layers only, same indices as ground.png

water.phaseRule: phase = (kitHash(tx ^ 0x77, ty ^ 0x99) % 4) · 2 (= floor(frames / 4)); shore tiles phase 0

lines.note: tracks: none detected from the painting yet (PACK open item)

M4.brief: rock <-> snow peaks, ONLY if the SNOW class share >= 0.5 % (fields.mjs report), else skipped

tolerance: exact: classes, ground, ring, sampledWet per vertex; detail doubles as IEEE-754 bits

water.phaseRule: phase = (kitHash(tx ^ 0x77, ty ^ 0x99) % 4) · 2 (= floor(frames / 4)); shore tiles phase 0

windowsNote: vertices (x0 + i·step, y0 + j·step), row-major; cls / ground one hex digit per vertex, ring 0/1, wet = sampledWet 0/1/2; step 7 = the MAP lattice config (latticeCfg); detail = [i, j, coast, inland, river, lake, bridge, island, plot, track] every 32nd vertex
